selection: Eight source-transfer configurations and four same-architecture no-source ablations. Primary chooses only preserved 49.28 control or source-transfer candidates. Accuracy, macro-F1, fixed order on pooled inner predictions. Final choice uses inner predictions only.
training_data: 41 genuine author-labeled EMU people with PHQ8=PHQ9-item9. Two unmatched transcripts quarantined. 163 original participants and all original splits preserved. No invented AV features or labels.
features: Shared fixed MiniLM384 and 16 original language features; interview-specific shared-text copy and AV128 PCA16 branch. Domain routing zeros deactivate missing AV branches; no AV imputation. Only target interview inputs used at inference.
preprocessing: Shared text scaling/PCA32 and language scaling on local fitting interviews plus external training people. AV scaler/PCA16 uses fitting original interviews only. Separate sqrt class weights within each cohort, external weight mass .25 or .75 of original; combined total weight normalized to original fitting count. No synthetic rows.
evaluation: Same original participant-wise5 outer/3 inner folds and seeds42/137/2026; external people always training only. Primary matched 49.28 control, no-source ablation to isolate transfer value. No official validation/test scoring. Exploratory history caveat remains.
stopping_rule: One new externally supervised transfer architecture, twelve fixed configurations including ablations. No post-result search expansion. Retain original best model if no verified improvement.
